proposal.description: Master_PWM goes through the short symmetric SPI glitch filter after its synchroniser, as if switch-node pickup on the modulator line needed the same 160 ns filter as SCK, so every block's cycle reference is delayed and short pulses are swallowed
proposal.reason: PWM_out now lags Osc_in by 8 more clocks than it should. Any modulator high or low pulse shorter than 8 clocks (160 ns) disappears from PWM_out and from the cycle counts in fault_arbiter, soft_start, pgood_gen and pwm_stats, which also changes the DUTY_COUNT and period telemetry for narrow pulses.
